About Eagle

A well-kept property starts with a great lawn.

Eagle Property Care is a Whangārei-based team that takes real pride in keeping homes and businesses looking their best. From routine lawn maintenance to full garden transformations, we show up on time, do the job properly and leave your place spotless.

Whether you need a single tidy-up before guests arrive or someone you can count on every fortnight, we’ve got you covered.
